title: Modernising legacy systems in UK banking and financial services
partialText: Software modernisation in banking and finance goes beyond replacing old code. It’s about navigating a risk-averse environment to transform everything from processes to culture. Here’s what we’ve learned about making it all work.

title: NWRUG's (Manchester, UK) November 2026 meeting — (Un)learning programming
partialText: Hear Sam Péchèr reflect on starting out as a junior just as the industry shifted to not writing code at NWRUG this month.
